verdict.rationale: Dynadot offers an AI Domain Search that generates name/TLD suggestions from a keyword input, which is a form of AI-generated suggestion, but this is not insight derived from the user's own account/domain data — it's a generative naming tool for new searches. No evidence of AI analyzing a user's existing portfolio, DNS records, or usage data to surface insights. Missing for 10: AI-driven analysis of the user's own domains/DNS/traffic data, dashboards or reports summarizing account data, and any indication the MCP/API layer surfaces AI-generated insights rather than just executing commands.
